hooks.command: command -v yammm-lsp >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'Warning: yammm-lsp binary not found in PATH. LSP features (diagnostics, completion, hover) will not work. Download a pre-built binary from https://github.com/simon-lentz/yammm-lsp/releases/latest (recommended), or build from source: git clone https://github.com/simon-lentz/yammm-lsp.git && cd yammm-lsp && make build. Run /setup-lsp for guided installation.'
